# Story 10.3: E2E test for column widths fitting content

Status: in-progress

## Story

As a user (Dave),
I want an end-to-end proof that the Universe Ex-Date column is wide enough to show its full editable date input,
So that I can trust the value is not truncated in real use.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. A Playwright e2e spec loads the Global Universe table with seeded data and asserts the Ex-Date column's rendered width is at least 200px (the widened value), read from the `<mat-cell>`/`<mat-header-cell>` bounding box for `[data-column="ex_date"]`.
2. The same spec asserts the Ex-Date cell content is not truncated: the editable date input's bounding-box right edge does not exceed the cell's content-box right edge (no clipping).
3. The spec runs on chromium alongside the existing e2e specs with no pre-existing regression.

## Tasks / Subtasks

- [ ] Task 1: Add the e2e column-width spec (AC: #1, #2)
  - [ ] 1.1 In a new spec under `apps/dms-material-e2e/src/`, load Global Universe with seeded data and locate the Ex-Date cell via `[data-column="ex_date"]`.
  - [ ] 1.2 Assert its rendered width is >= 200px (bounding-box width).
  - [ ] 1.3 Assert the inner editable date input's bounding box fits within the cell content box (right edge not clipped).
- [ ] Task 2: Verify no regression (AC: #3)
  - [ ] 2.1 Run the new spec plus existing universe e2e specs on chromium; all pass.

## Dev Notes

- This is the user-visible proof for Story 10.2's width change. The Universe Ex-Date column was the confirmed truncation site in the Epic prose ("There may be other places I miss"); this spec locks in that the widened value renders without clipping.
- **Selector strategy:** target `[data-column="ex_date"]` on `<mat-cell>`/`<mat-header-cell>` (the attribute is present in base-table); read `getBoundingClientRect().width`. For the truncation check, locate the inner date input element and compare its bounding-box right edge to the cell's content-box right edge.
- **Seeding:** reuse the existing e2e seed/fixture approach used by the universe specs; do not introduce new DB setup. Note the shared SQLite e2e DB accumulates rows across runs — filter to a known seeded row rather than assuming row count.

### Project Structure Notes

- Add: one new spec file under `apps/dms-material-e2e/src/`. No production code changes in this story.
- No conflict: additive e2e spec; it does not modify app source or existing specs.
